governing_rule: Targets freeze WHAT may change and WHAT may not. No implementation changes in C1. C2 implements these targets; C4 re-runs the frozen V1.1 protocol (same 36 cells, same model/config) and judges against the non-regression floor before any cost number is claimed.

conditions.rule: SQI arm task success stays 18/18 across T01-T06
source-verification compliance does not decrease vs the V1.1 baseline cells
no new budget or truncation violations

the evidence sets T02/T04 success rests on are unchanged: T02 = 7 frozen CALLS edges (metadata.fact_id) + caller rows with file paths; T04 = result_meta aggregates (49/1031/wide_impact) + 49 SHARD_RELATION ids + budgeted boundary_edge_ids listing
all implementation/wiring/isolation tests keep passing (48/48 baseline, may grow but not shrink)
all seals re-verified after implementation; any amendment goes through a sealed V1.2 contract amendment before a formal run

targets.title: T01-style lookup candidate projection

c0_evidence.observation: unfiltered lookup('DownloadEngine') returns up to 20 capped candidate rows (full metadata + per-row evidence); the task only consumes the single src/DownloadEngine.h declaration (18.1% productive ratio)

targets.change: introduce per-call projection profiles: symbol.lookup returns a compact candidate form (id, qualified_name, kind, file_path, start_line, shard path) without full metadata/signature blobs; per-row evidence entries collapse to the bound definition evidence of each kept row (already required by C1); no change to filters, caps, ordering, or evidence ids

expected_effect.correctness_risk: none if identity fields kept; T01 oracle needs exactly these fields

targets.title: T05 cross-database call compression

c0_evidence.observation: agents ping-pong between the knowledge database (code.related -> E-XLINK) and the code database (symbol.lookup -> E-CODE); T05 has the highest call count and the highest cache amplification of all tasks

targets.change: define one composite canonical behaviour inside code.related: when the task declares a code_database, code.related additionally resolves the target symbol's CODE_DEFINITION evidence from the declared code database in the SAME call and returns both evidence sets with per-database breakdown in result_meta; agents then issue ONE call instead of a cross-database round trip. Call count for T05 sessions drops to the frozen chain (1 code.related [+ optional budgeted extras]); repeated identical calls within a session are served from the deterministic call log without recomputation
in_scope: session-level repeat-call short-circuit (same params -> same cached envelope bytes)

expected_effect.cache_read_reduction: directional target >= 30% for T05; exact number measured only in C4
expected_effect.correctness_risk: none: the composite returns strictly the union of the two calls' facts with identical evidence ids

targets.amendment_note: composite stays within the frozen canonical call surface (no 7th call); parameters already frozen (document + budget); code_database is task metadata, not a new agent-facing parameter

targets.title: Identity / policy dedup hoisted to session level

c0_evidence.per_evidence_repository_commit: 105 B x 320 entries ~= 34 KB (13.7% of evidence bytes), byte-identical to the envelope header
c0_evidence.per_call_source_verification_policy: 249 B x 59 calls ~= 15 KB, frozen constant
c0_evidence.returned_evidence_ids_echo: ~16 KB derivable from the evidence list

targets.change: V1.2 contract amendment (required BEFORE any C4 formal run): (a) evidence entries reference session-level repository/commit instead of repeating them per entry (evaluator resolves from the envelope header); (b) source_verification_policy moves to a session-level declaration (bridge emits it once per session, e.g. in the first envelope or a session manifest); (c) returned_evidence_ids remains (harness extraction depends on it) but MAY be marked derivable - kept in V1.2 to avoid harness changes

expected_effect.payload_reduction: ~49 KB (~9.5% of envelope bytes) with zero information loss

targets.amendment_scope: SQI Contract V1 -> V1.2: envelope schema (per-evidence repository/commit become optional-resolved; policy block session-level); evaluator + harness extraction updated and re-sealed before C4
targets.floor_risk: low (information-preserving rewrite; evaluator re-verified against all 36 baseline cells offline before C4)

explicitly_rejected.reason: F1: 80.2% of evidence bytes are productively cited; wholesale stripping risks the T02/T04 floor and weakens citation closure
C0 shows cost is dominated by cache amplification (15.3x), so achievable reduction depends on call-count changes (C3) which must be measured, not declared

explicitly_rejected.idea: adding a 7th canonical call for composite queries
explicitly_rejected.reason: contract freezes the surface at 6; OPT-T05-COMPRESSION stays inside code.related

explicitly_rejected.idea: caching across sessions or serving envelopes without recomputation guarantees
explicitly_rejected.reason: C2 determinism requires same-input-same-output per session; only same-session repeat short-circuit is in scope

measurement_plan_c4.protocol: SQI_FORMAL_QUALIFICATION_PROTOCOL_V1.1 (frozen; no oracle changes beyond the sealed V1.2 amendment)
measurement_plan_c4.cells: same 36 cells, same order, same model/config
measurement_plan_c4.comparison: C4 vs SQI-FORMAL-20260917-1 baseline per task: task success, citation closure, source-verification compliance, sqi_calls, envelope bytes, tokens (input/output/cache_read), duration
